q: Does a travel agency count its clients' flights in its emissions?
title: Travel agency and client flights
short: Not in its core inventory. The airline burns the fuel, and the trip is the client's business travel. The agency counts its offices, staff travel and commuting. It can report the emissions of trips it sold as a separate, optional figure and explain the method, which corporate clients often ask for.
audience: Travel agencies and corporate travel desks

ul: Staff travel and commuting: Categories 6 and 7.
IT and booking systems: purchased services.

p: Give clients per-trip figures using a named factor set, so they can add them to their own Category 6.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
